Class AppDataFolder

java.lang.Object
io.mcs.taskmanager.shared.AppDataFolder
public final class AppDataFolder extends Object
Where the Task Manager keeps its data on this computer: the database, for the signed-in Windows user, in %LOCALAPPDATA%\TaskManager. Local rather than roaming, so the database is never copied around with the user's profile; never beside the program, where the user may not be allowed to write.
Author:
Hamza Rasool, Abdullah Khan

  • Method Details

    • create

      public static Path create()
      Finds the folder, making it if this is the first start: SQLite makes the database file but not the folders above it. Outside Windows, where there is no LOCALAPPDATA, it is a hidden folder in the user's home.
      Returns:
      the folder, which exists once this returns
      Throws:
      UncheckedIOException - if the folder could not be made
